questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: A shopkeeper buys an item for ₹500 and makes 20% profit. What is SP?
questions.solution: Profit=20% of 500=100, so SP=600.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.question: 20% increase followed by 20% decrease gives what net change?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.solution: Differences are 3,5,7; next difference 9, so 26.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: He ___ to school every day.
questions.solution: Singular subject He takes goes in the simple present.

questions.subject: Polity
questions.question: Fundamental Rights are mainly contained in which Part of the Constitution?
questions.solution: Fundamental Rights are in Part III.

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: What is the SI unit of power?
questions.solution: Power is measured in watt (W).
